notes: Big uploads. A multi-page PDF (or anything over 5 MB) now goes to Drive in chunks instead of one request Google can refuse, and the button counts the upload up in percent instead of sitting on “Uploading…”. A connection that drops, or a sign-in that goes stale half-way, now carries on from where the upload really got to rather than starting again. Nothing changes for an ordinary screenshot: that is still the same single request it always was.
